name: Coffee
description: Coffee originated in Africa and was later cultivated and traded across the Arabian Peninsula before spreading to Europe and eventually becoming a global crop.

events.title: Coffee plants originated in Ethiopia
events.description: Coffee plants of the genus Coffea are native to the highlands of Ethiopia, which are widely regarded as the botanical origin of Arabica coffee.

events.title: Coffee was cultivated in Yemen
events.description: Coffee was cultivated in Yemen and became associated with the development of coffee-drinking culture and early commercial coffee trade.

events.title: Coffee was traded through the Arabian Peninsula
events.description: Coffee was traded through the Arabian Peninsula and Red Sea commercial networks.

events.title: Coffee spread through the Ottoman Empire
events.description: Coffee spread through Ottoman territories during the sixteenth century, and coffeehouses became important social institutions.

events.title: Coffee reached European markets
events.description: Coffee reached European markets during the seventeenth century and gradually developed into a major commercial beverage.
